text.text_excerpt: Cozy brunch spot! My husband and I ended up here after a Sunday morning run. I had to try the iced chicory coffee because I had read great reviews about it and it sure was yum! My husband got a double espresso and though it was good. I do think that the price point for the coffee and main dishes is a little on the high side. We both got the BEATT and it was delicious. The brioche is so delicious! The wait time was a tad long but I'll wait for quality any day. The seating is so cute, there's table with chairs on one side and a long bench on the other along with a high bar. This is such a cute small place. Not only do they have awesome coffee they have awesome breakfast. On weekends they have brunch and it is amazing! I want to go back every weekend for brunch! Try it! I love getting the combo special of breakfast burrito and iced coffee for 5 dollars on the weekdays.

Walked in on a Saturday morning (it's on a block of Magazine near Napolean where there is a bunch of shops and restaurants, so it can be easy to miss) and it was super clean and inviting. The place has a modern feel to it, but it isn't pretentious. The selection of coffees, teas, food, and pastries is just perfect. You order at the front and the staff brings the food and drinks to your table. I ordered an iced coffee with cream which came in a mason jar and tasted great (not too strong and very refreshing) and the B.E.E.A.T. which included bacon, a poached egg, arugula, avocado, and tomato on housemade brioche toast.
